# The shen-go stage-1 host pin: ONE SHA, read by every workflow that needs a
# Shen host.  Three workflows need it (go.yml's host-test, analysis-oracle.yml,
# parity-gate.yml); three hand-copied constants with three hand-written
# comments would drift, and the next mover would have to find all three.  The
# steps that read this file take the first bare 40-hex line below.
#
# Why pinned at all: shen-go doubles as the stage-1 host, so an unpinned
# "whatever master is tonight" makes a red run unattributable -- rules, shake,
# rendering, or host?  It is the same reason analysis-oracle.yml pins its
# Soufflé version.  docs/analysis-rules.md records that shen-go master has been
# broken before (`5edf47e` panics in cmd/yggdrasil-build; `24b2c00` was the
# last good one).  The jobs here need `cmd/shen`, which builds and boots at the
# pin below.
#
# What moving the pin to `30ab469` (PR #48, "kl-fail-filler-and-native-install-
# order") bought, measured on this branch: cmd/kl, the bare KLambda VM, no
# longer panics during (shen.initialise) -- `yggdrasil run tests/fib.shen OUT
# --target kl` prints `fib 20 = 6765` with no `Panic:` / `Recovered in Eval` /
# `goroutine ` line, and `trace-check tests/fib.shen OUT --target kl` reports
# `OK called=33` with `phase: boot=28 program=11`.  And the generated `go`
# artifact's main now calls InstallKernelFast after EVERY kernel chunk, inside
# the chunk loop and so before the kernel's own init pass, which is what makes
# `native_overrides_installed_after: before-initialise` true in builders.json
# and what opens `yggdrasil lower --target go`.
#
# Moving this SHA is a deliberate act, and the mover owns whatever the new host
# changes.  Moved 2026-10-11 for the ShenOSKernel 42.2 retarget
# (pyrex41/yggdrasil#32) to the head of shen-go's `kernel-42.2` branch
# (pyrex41/shen-go, refs/heads/kernel-42.2), then re-pinned to the merge
# commit of pyrex41/shen-go#62 on master, `1f587de` (its second parent is the
# reviewed branch head `91fc6ee`, so the tree under test is unchanged).  The vendored slice and
# the stage-1 host must run the same kernel, and 30ab469 runs Tarver's S42.0.
# What the move bought, measured on this branch: as a host it shakes fib,
# prolog, metaeval and read-data byte-identically to shen-cl `kernel-42.2`;
# `trace-check --target go` and `--target kl` pass on fib, prolog and
# partial (go also on stdin-sum); and shen-go now installs its natives
# unconditionally, so `yggdrasil lower-check --target go` PASSES
# (docs/lowering.md).  Previous pin, PR #48:
#   30ab4692fc5a2750ee61845cb1bdc96d60f4aca8
# Retargeted 2026-10-18 to community ShenOSKernel 43.1. The previous
# 1f587de pin runs 42.2 and is rejected by the new stage-1 kernel guard.
# acba88a includes the complete release, public stream interfaces and byte-port
# refusal without input consumption; canonical 154/154 and KL certification pass.
acba88a3f189f055285a9bdb22901ad688db7cd3
